.claude-plugin/plugin.json.why: Two version lines. This repository's marketplace (ADR 0044) versions the plugin it serves, and the incubator assigns its own on promotion. Everything else in the manifest must match.

skills/*/SKILL.md.why: Each copy names its own repository's skill map: docs/02-skill-family.md here, docs/skill-relationship-map.md in the incubator, which substitutes it on promotion (docs/05-promotion.md row 8). Nothing else may differ. Widened to the gates and register-install on re-recording at 0.1.21, once ADR 0059 revision 2 shipped (incubator#1247 to #1253) and the incubator's review fixes were taken back. register-adopt and register-variance folded in on re-recording at 0.1.22, once #1258 shipped and the incubator's 'whose rows list the skills' sentence was taken back. Widened to every skill on re-recording at 0.1.26, once ADR 0062's release set adr-0062-answered-once shipped (incubator#1324 to #1331) unchanged: the six gates' and register-adopt's SKILL.md differ from the published copies only in this link.
